title: Robin's Secret Tome
description: A mod featuring a mysterious tome, for the Origins Discord Secret Jam
body:
This mod was made for the Origin's discord Secret Jam! If you wish for its features to remain a secret, do not look below!

This mod is unfortunately incomplete due to time restrictions, I may finish the concept later fleshing it out with the features I wanted to implement originally.

<details>
<summary>Secret Spoilers</summary>
This mod adds in a guide manual for playing the game. You spawn with it in your hands, and you do not need to right click it to look at it. instead it renders like a map, appearing in your hands when held.

This mod uses origins for the book system, and has implemented a basic framework for creating custom guide books using just origins, lang files, and images! This framework is currently incompleted, as I had to remove a feature that made the pages unlockable.
</details>
